method: Saved per-crossing spatial-bin mean posture height including stops; empirical CDF over equal-spaced common bins, then mean crossing CDF per mouse, then mean across mice. Paired mouse D14-D0 CDF difference. These are distributions of spatial-bin mean heights, not instantaneous frame heights.

support.rule: Complete finite support across all 251 D0/D14 crossings; no interpolation. Approximate tape limits42..1243; 700/1201 mm per pixel. Outcome-specific complete support; see excluded bin list.

statistics: Descriptive only. Paired-mouse SEM for change; not cage-adjusted inference or simultaneous confidence.
interpretation: CDF shift right means higher posture. Negative change means fewer positions at or below that height at D14.
